CustomField.description: List of '|' separated IDs of auto-matched Chat Topics that are possibly related to this Case. Populated by 'New' Case button override logic, while trying to auto-link a Chat Topic to a Case. This will be helpful in troubleshooting activities to understand why Chat - Case auto-link might not have happened. This will only be populated in the extremely rare case where a customer might have more than one active Chat session at the same time.
